subject: Homepage picture looks blurry
body:
Hi team,

I uploaded a new photo for the big banner at the top of our homepage and it looks stretched and a bit blurry on my laptop. What size should that image actually be? I'd rather get it right before I ask our photographer for more.

Thanks,
Megan

mustInclude: recommended homepage background size roughly 700x250px up to 1400x400px
mustNotInclude: a single exact size presented as the only option

subject: member wants money back

ravi

some payment gateways block refunds or need time (e.g. 24 hours) first

subject: Set up info@ forwarding
body:
Hello,

Could you tell me how to set up an email forwarder so anything sent to info@ our domain lands in my Gmail? I found the email area in the admin but can't see where forwarders are.

Laura

mustInclude: email forwarders are no longer supported (removed in June 2024)
mustNotInclude: step-by-step instructions to create a forwarder in cPanel

subject: Cambiar el idioma del sitio
body:
Hola,

Tenemos el directorio en inglés pero la mayoría de nuestros miembros hablan español. ¿Cómo puedo cambiar el idioma del sitio? Y si es posible, ¿se puede ofrecer los dos idiomas a la vez?

Gracias,
Lucía

mustInclude: reply written in Spanish
default language is set under Settings » General Settings » Localization
Google Website Translator add-on for offering several languages

subject: Order of results
body:
Hi,

On our members search page the newest members show up last. Can we flip it so new people show first, or sort by name? Where do I change that?

Cheers, Tom

mustInclude: My Content > Edit Post Settings, then the Search Results Design tab
'Order Results By' under Additional Settings

subject: Salesforce sync?
body:
Hi,

Our sales team lives in Salesforce. Is there a way to automatically push every new member signup from the directory into Salesforce as a lead? Where do I switch that on?

Priya

mustInclude: says the help center does not document a native Salesforce sync
offers to check options with the team

subject: Bulk add members + categories question
body:
Hey there,

Two things:
1. We have a spreadsheet of about 300 plumbing companies. What's the fastest way to get them all into the directory as members without typing each one?
2. A lot of them do both plumbing and HVAC. Can a member pick more than one main category? Right now it only lets them pick one.

Thanks!
Daniel

mustInclude: import members from a CSV file using the import template
members can select only one top-level category
workaround: a general top-level category with the old ones as sub-categories

subject: hide site til launch
body:
hey can i hide the website from the public while we finish adding restaurants?? like a coming soon page. launch is in 2 weeks

thx kim

mustInclude: Settings > General Settings > Website Status set to Staging Mode
staging mode adds noindex so search engines don't crawl it

Greg Walsh

subject: Can't log into admin - too many redirects
body:
Hello,

When I try to log into the admin area Chrome says "too many redirects" and won't load. Our SSL isn't set up yet. My colleague on Safari can log in fine. Which setting do I need to change in Chrome?

Oliver

mustInclude: turn off Chrome's 'Always use secure connections' setting (Settings > Privacy and security)
recommends installing an SSL certificate

subject: firefox wont load admin
body:
hi firefox keeps looping when i open my admin login, says page isnt redirecting properly. what exactly do i click in firefox to stop this? your article only shows a picture and i cant read it on my phone

ines

mustInclude: in Firefox settings choose 'Don't enable HTTPS-Only Mode'

subject: Re: Moving our domain
body:
Hi again,

Since we moved the domain over last week our info@ mailbox hasn't received a single email. Sent ones go out fine. Did we break something when we switched?

Sam

thread.body: Hi Sam, to connect your domain you can either point the nameservers to us or add a CNAME record. Let us know which you prefer.
Thanks. Our domain is at GoDaddy, I just changed the nameservers to yours like the guide said.
Great, the site is now live on your domain. Shout if anything looks off.

mustInclude: GoDaddy nameservers are known not to receive email with the platform
point the domain with a CNAME record instead of the nameservers

subject: map broken
